mapper.select: Select APPROVAL_STATUS AS approvalStatus, ACTIVITY_NAME AS activityName, PROFILE_IMAGE AS profileImage, CREATOR_INTRODUCTION as creatorIntroduction, SETTLEMENT_ACCOUNT as settlementAccount, SETTLEMENT_ACCOUNT_IMG as settlementAccountImg, ACTIVITY_REGION as activityRegion, SNS_URL as snsUrl from creator where operator_code=#{creatorCode}

SELECT class_code AS classCode, name AS name, price AS price, desired_price AS desiredPrice, address AS address,
CASE WHEN price IS NOT NULL AND price > 0 AND desired_price IS NOT NULL AND desired_price > price THEN ROUND(((desired_price - price) / desired_price) * 100) ELSE 0 END AS discountRate FROM class WHERE operator_code = #{creatorCode}
SELECT COALESCE(AVG(star_rating), 0.0) AS averageRating, COUNT(*) AS totalReviewCount FROM review r JOIN class c ON r.class_code = c.class_code WHERE c.operator_code = #{creatorCode}

SELECT r.content AS content, r.star_rating AS starRating, r.input_date AS inputDate, m.name as userName, m.image as userImg FROM review r JOIN class c ON r.class_code = c.class_code JOIN member m ON r.member_code = m.member_code WHERE c.operator_code = #{creatorCode} ORDER BY r.input_date DESC
